examples.en: The island is covered with thick green vegetation.
examples.zh: 這座島被濃密的綠色植物覆蓋。

examples.en: Heavy rain helps the vegetation grow along the river.
examples.zh: 大雨有助於河岸的植被生長。

examples.en: We studied the local vegetation in our science class.
examples.zh: 我們在自然課上研究了當地的植被。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to calculate the velocity of the car.
examples.zh: 老師要我們計算這輛車的速度。

examples.en: Wind velocity increased sharply before the storm arrived.
examples.zh: 暴風雨來臨前，風速急遽增加。

examples.en: The ball hit the wall at a high velocity.
examples.zh: 球以很高的速度撞上了牆。

examples.en: Street sellers vend snacks outside the night market.
examples.zh: 小販在夜市外頭販賣小吃。

examples.en: The shop is licensed to vend tickets for the concert.
examples.zh: 這家店獲准販售演唱會門票。

examples.en: Machines in the hall vend drinks and light meals.
examples.zh: 大廳裡的機器販售飲料和輕食。

examples.en: Warm air came out of the vent near the window.
examples.zh: 暖氣從窗邊的通風口吹出來。

examples.en: The kitchen vent removes smoke while we cook.
examples.zh: 廚房的通風口會在我們煮菜時排出油煙。

examples.en: Please keep the vent clear so air can pass through.
examples.zh: 請保持通風口暢通，讓空氣流通。

examples.en: She called her friend to vent her anger after the meeting.
examples.zh: 開完會後，她打電話給朋友宣洩怒氣。

examples.en: Some students vent their stress by playing sports.
examples.zh: 有些學生靠運動來宣洩壓力。

examples.en: It is better to vent your feelings than to hide them.
examples.zh: 與其隱藏情緒，不如把感受宣洩出來。

examples.en: Please open the windows to ventilate the classroom.
examples.zh: 請打開窗戶讓教室通風。

examples.en: The kitchen is well ventilated by a large fan.
examples.zh: 廚房有一台大風扇，通風良好。

examples.en: We must ventilate the room after painting the walls.
examples.zh: 粉刷牆壁後，我們必須讓房間通風。

examples.en: The old farmhouse stood on the verge of the forest.
examples.zh: 那棟老農舍位於森林的邊緣。

examples.en: The company is on the verge of closing its store.
examples.zh: 這家公司眼看就要關閉店面了。

examples.en: Wild flowers grew along the verge of the road.
examples.zh: 野花沿著路邊生長。

examples.en: Please verify your email address before you log in.
examples.zh: 登入前請先確認您的電子郵件地址。

examples.en: The clerk asked me to verify my phone number.
examples.zh: 店員請我核對我的電話號碼。

examples.en: Scientists need to verify the results with more tests.
examples.zh: 科學家需要用更多實驗來證實結果。

examples.en: The vicar welcomed everyone to the village church.
examples.zh: 教區牧師歡迎大家來到村裡的教堂。

examples.en: Our vicar gives a short talk every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 我們的教區牧師每週日早上都會做簡短的講道。

examples.en: The villagers asked the vicar to help with the charity sale.
examples.zh: 村民請教區牧師協助義賣活動。

examples.en: There is a good bakery in the vicinity of our school.
examples.zh: 我們學校附近有一家不錯的麵包店。

examples.en: Few hotels in the vicinity offer free breakfast.
examples.zh: 附近很少有旅館提供免費早餐。

examples.en: Police asked people in the vicinity to stay home.
examples.zh: 警方請附近的居民留在家中。

examples.en: Online scammers often victimize elderly people.
examples.zh: 網路詐騙集團常常讓年長者受害。

examples.en: The school has a rule against anyone who tries to victimize new students.
examples.zh: 學校規定不准任何人欺負新生。

examples.en: Shoppers should be careful not to be victimized by fake websites.
examples.zh: 購物時要小心，不要被假網站所騙。

examples.en: Our team was victorious in the final game.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍在決賽中獲勝。

examples.en: The victorious players held up the trophy.
examples.zh: 獲勝的球員高舉獎盃。

examples.en: She felt victorious after finishing the long race.
examples.zh: 跑完這場漫長的比賽後，她覺得自己是勝利者。

examples.en: Every villager came to the festival in the square.
examples.zh: 每位村民都來參加廣場上的慶典。

examples.en: The villagers share water from a well near the temple.
examples.zh: 村民共用廟旁一口井的水。

examples.en: A friendly villager showed us the way to the farm.
examples.zh: 一位友善的村民為我們指引了去農場的路。

examples.en: She bought a vintage dress at the flea market.
examples.zh: 她在跳蚤市場買了一件復古洋裝。

examples.en: My uncle drives a vintage car from the 1960s.
examples.zh: 我叔叔開一輛六〇年代的老爺車。

examples.en: The cafe is decorated with vintage posters and old lamps.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡店用復古海報和舊燈具佈置。

senses.zh: 釀酒葡萄的收成年份；特定年份的葡萄酒

examples.en: This wine is from an excellent vintage.
examples.zh: 這瓶酒來自一個很棒的年份。

examples.en: The vintage of the bottle is printed on the label.
examples.zh: 酒瓶的年份印在標籤上。

examples.en: Experts say the 2015 vintage was the best in ten years.
examples.zh: 專家說二〇一五年份的酒是十年來最好的。

examples.en: The floor is covered with easy-to-clean vinyl.
examples.zh: 地板上鋪著容易清潔的乙烯基塑膠。

examples.en: My father still listens to music on vinyl instead of streaming it.
examples.zh: 我爸爸仍用黑膠唱片聽音樂，而不是串流播放。

examples.en: The bag is made of vinyl, so it keeps the rain out.
examples.zh: 這個袋子是乙烯基塑膠做的，所以可以防雨。

examples.en: The park is virtually empty on weekday mornings.
examples.zh: 平日早上公園幾乎沒有人。

examples.en: The two phones are virtually the same in price.
examples.zh: 這兩支手機的價格幾乎一樣。

examples.en: Students can visit the museum virtually from home.
examples.zh: 學生在家就能以虛擬方式參觀博物館。

examples.en: Try to visualize the story as you read it.
examples.zh: 閱讀時試著在腦海中想像故事的畫面。

examples.en: Charts help us visualize the data more clearly.
examples.zh: 圖表幫助我們更清楚地看見資料。

examples.en: I can visualize myself standing on the stage.
examples.zh: 我能想像自己站在舞台上的樣子。

examples.en: Short skirts were in vogue that summer.
examples.zh: 那年夏天短裙很流行。

examples.en: Wearing large hats is back in vogue this year.
examples.zh: 今年戴大帽子又開始流行了。

examples.en: Her style went out of vogue many years ago.
examples.zh: 她的風格許多年前就不流行了。

examples.en: The empty chair left a void in the family.
examples.zh: 那張空椅子在家中留下了一片空虛。

examples.en: Stars shine in the dark void of space.
examples.zh: 星星在黑暗空曠的太空中閃耀。

examples.en: Nothing could fill the void after his best friend moved away.
examples.zh: 最好的朋友搬走後，沒有什麼能填補他心中的空缺。

examples.en: The contract is void if both sides do not sign it.
examples.zh: 如果雙方沒有簽名，這份合約就無效。

examples.en: This ticket is void after the date printed on it.
examples.zh: 這張票過了印在上面的日期就無效。

examples.en: The judge said the agreement was null and void.
examples.zh: 法官說這項協議無效。

examples.en: The price of oil has been volatile this year.
examples.zh: 今年的油價一直起伏不定。

examples.en: Alcohol is a volatile liquid that evaporates quickly.
examples.zh: 酒精是一種容易揮發的液體。

examples.en: He has a volatile temper, so we try not to upset him.
examples.zh: 他的脾氣很不穩定，所以我們盡量不惹他不高興。

examples.en: A typical AA alkaline battery provides about one and a half volts.
examples.zh: 一般的 AA 鹼性電池大約提供一點五伏特的電壓。

examples.en: This charger works at 110 volts.
examples.zh: 這個充電器在一百一十伏特下運作。

examples.en: The teacher measured six volts across the battery with a small meter.
examples.zh: 老師用小型電表量得電池兩端的電壓為六伏特。

examples.en: High voltage can be dangerous, so keep away from the wires.
examples.zh: 高電壓可能很危險，所以請遠離電線。

examples.en: Household outlets in Taiwan commonly supply a voltage of 110 or 220 volts.
examples.zh: 台灣家用插座常供應一百一十或二百二十伏特的電壓。

examples.en: A drop in voltage made the lights flicker.
examples.zh: 電壓下降讓燈光閃爍。

examples.en: He was embarrassed by his friend's vulgar jokes.
examples.zh: 他對朋友的粗俗笑話感到尷尬。

examples.en: The teacher asked the class not to use vulgar language.
examples.zh: 老師要求全班不要使用粗俗的言語。

examples.en: The restaurant's decoration looked bright but vulgar.
examples.zh: 那家餐廳的裝潢看起來很鮮豔，卻很俗氣。

examples.en: The children wade into the shallow stream to catch fish.
examples.zh: 孩子們蹚進淺溪裡抓魚。

examples.en: We had to wade across the river to reach the camp.
examples.zh: 我們得涉水過河才能到達營地。

examples.en: After the typhoon, people waded through the flooded street.
examples.zh: 颱風過後，人們蹚過淹水的街道。

examples.en: The baby began to wail when his mother left the room.
examples.zh: 媽媽離開房間時，嬰兒開始嚎啕大哭。

examples.en: Sirens wailed in the distance all night.
examples.zh: 警笛整晚在遠處呼嘯。

examples.en: The little girl wailed because she lost her toy.
examples.zh: 小女孩因為弄丟玩具而哭得很大聲。

examples.en: A loud wail came from the next room.
examples.zh: 隔壁房間傳來一聲響亮的哀號。

examples.en: We heard the wail of a siren outside.
examples.zh: 我們聽到外面傳來警笛的哀鳴。

examples.en: The child let out a wail when he fell down.
examples.zh: 那個孩子跌倒時發出一聲哀號。

examples.en: We chose light blue wallpaper for the bedroom.
examples.zh: 我們為臥室挑了淺藍色的壁紙。

examples.en: She changed the wallpaper on her phone to a photo of her dog.
examples.zh: 她把手機桌布換成她的狗的照片。

examples.en: The old wallpaper began to peel off the wall.
examples.zh: 舊壁紙開始從牆上剝落。

examples.en: They plan to wallpaper the living room this weekend.
examples.zh: 他們打算這個週末幫客廳貼壁紙。

examples.en: My parents wallpapered the hallway themselves to save money on decorating.
examples.zh: 我爸媽為了節省裝潢費，自己幫走廊貼了壁紙。

examples.en: It took us a whole day to wallpaper the small room.
examples.zh: 我們花了一整天才把那間小房間貼好壁紙。

examples.en: The shop sells kitchenware and other household ware.
examples.zh: 這家店販售廚房用品和其他家用器皿。

examples.en: The vendor laid out his wares on a cloth.
examples.zh: 小販把自己的商品攤放在一塊布上。

examples.en: Ceramic ware made in this town is famous around the world.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮製作的陶瓷器皿聞名全世界。

examples.en: The two warring sides finally agreed to talk.
examples.zh: 交戰的雙方終於同意談判。

examples.en: The history teacher explained why the warring states fought.
examples.zh: 歷史老師說明了交戰各國為何開戰。

examples.en: Aid workers delivered food to families caught between the warring sides.
examples.zh: 救援人員把食物送給受困於交戰雙方之間的家庭。

examples.en: Food was hard to find in wartime.
examples.zh: 戰時很難找到食物。

examples.en: My grandmother often tells stories about wartime.
examples.zh: 我奶奶常常說起戰爭時期的故事。

examples.en: The museum shows letters written during wartime.
examples.zh: 博物館展出戰時寫的信件。

examples.en: The boat has a watertight cover to keep supplies dry.
examples.zh: 這艘船有防水的蓋子，能讓補給品保持乾燥。

examples.en: This watertight bag is perfect for the beach.
examples.zh: 這個防水袋很適合帶去海邊。

examples.en: The lawyer presented a watertight argument in court.
examples.zh: 律師在法庭上提出了無懈可擊的論點。

examples.en: This light bulb uses only ten watts of power.
examples.zh: 這顆燈泡的耗電功率只有十瓦。

examples.en: The microwave is rated at 800 watts.
examples.zh: 這台微波爐的額定功率是八百瓦。

examples.en: At full power, a heater rated at more watts uses more energy per second.
examples.zh: 全功率運轉時，額定瓦數較高的暖爐每秒消耗的電能較多。

examples.en: Her way-out outfit made everyone look twice.
examples.zh: 她古怪的打扮讓每個人都多看了兩眼。

examples.en: The designer is known for his way-out ideas.
examples.zh: 這位設計師以他前衛的點子聞名。

examples.en: Some people thought the film was too way-out for kids.
examples.zh: 有些人認為這部電影對孩子來說太古怪了。

senses.zh: 弱點；虛弱；難以抗拒的喜好

examples.en: Shyness is his biggest weakness at work.
examples.zh: 害羞是他工作上最大的弱點。

examples.en: Illness left her with a feeling of weakness.
examples.zh: 生病讓她感到虛弱無力。

examples.en: Everyone has a weakness, and mine is chocolate.
examples.zh: 每個人都有弱點，而我的弱點是巧克力。

examples.en: He put a wedge under the door to keep it open.
examples.zh: 他在門下塞了一個楔子讓門保持敞開。

examples.en: She cut the cake into six wedges.
examples.zh: 她把蛋糕切成六個楔形小塊。

examples.en: The cheese was served in small wedges.
examples.zh: 起司被切成小楔形後端上桌。

examples.en: He wedged a book under the table leg.
examples.zh: 他把一本書塞在桌腳下。

examples.en: She wedged her bag between two boxes.
examples.zh: 她把包包塞進兩個箱子之間。

examples.en: The crowd wedged us into a corner of the train.
examples.zh: 擁擠的人群把我們擠進車廂的角落。

examples.en: The wee kitten fell asleep in her hand.
examples.zh: 那隻小小的小貓在她手裡睡著了。

examples.en: It was a wee village with only ten houses.
examples.zh: 那是一個只有十戶人家的小村莊。

examples.en: He gave me a wee piece of cake.
examples.zh: 他給了我一小塊蛋糕。

examples.en: Workers weld the steel pipes together at the factory.
examples.zh: 工人在工廠裡把鋼管焊接在一起。

examples.en: He learned how to weld in a vocational school.
examples.zh: 他在職業學校學會了焊接。

examples.en: The bicycle frame was welded by hand.
examples.zh: 這輛腳踏車的車架是手工焊接的。

examples.en: The weld on the metal gate is very strong.
examples.zh: 金屬大門上的焊接處非常牢固。

examples.en: The inspector checked each weld for cracks.
examples.zh: 檢查員逐一檢查每道焊縫有沒有裂痕。

examples.en: A crack appeared along the weld.
examples.zh: 焊縫上出現了一道裂痕。

examples.en: Regular exercise is good for your well-being.
examples.zh: 規律運動對你的身心健康有益。

examples.en: The teacher cares about the well-being of every student.
examples.zh: 老師很在乎每位學生的福祉。

examples.en: Sleep plays a big role in our well-being.
examples.zh: 睡眠對我們的身心安適有重要影響。

examples.en: The school has a system whereby students can borrow laptops.
examples.zh: 學校有一套制度，學生可以憑此借用筆記型電腦。

examples.en: They made a plan whereby everyone shares the cost.
examples.zh: 他們擬定了一個辦法，讓每個人分攤費用。

examples.en: The club introduced a rule whereby members must sign in.
examples.zh: 社團制定了一條規則，要求成員必須簽到。

examples.en: She read a magazine whilst waiting for the bus.
examples.zh: 她等公車時看了一本雜誌。

examples.en: Whilst I enjoy cooking, I do not like washing the dishes.
examples.zh: 我雖然喜歡下廚，卻不喜歡洗碗。

examples.en: Please keep your phone off whilst the film is playing.
examples.zh: 電影播放期間請將手機關機。

examples.en: Leaves whirled in the wind outside the school gate.
examples.zh: 樹葉在校門外的風中打轉。

examples.en: The dancers whirled around the room as the music grew faster.
examples.zh: 隨著音樂加快，舞者們在房間裡旋轉。

examples.en: My head whirled after the long ride.
examples.zh: 搭了那段長途車之後，我頭昏眼花。

examples.en: The skater did a whirl on the ice.
examples.zh: 溜冰選手在冰上轉了一圈。

examples.en: The week before the exam was a whirl of studying.
examples.zh: 考試前的那一週是一陣讀書的忙亂。

examples.en: Let's give the new game a whirl.
examples.zh: 我們來試玩看看這個新遊戲吧。

examples.en: She used a whisk to mix the eggs and milk.
examples.zh: 她用打蛋器把雞蛋和牛奶拌勻。

examples.en: A metal whisk hangs on the kitchen wall.
examples.zh: 一支金屬打蛋器掛在廚房牆上。

examples.en: Please wash the whisk after you finish baking.
examples.zh: 烘焙完請把打蛋器洗乾淨。

examples.en: Whisk the eggs until they are light and fluffy.
examples.zh: 把蛋打到變得蓬鬆輕盈。

examples.en: The waiter whisked away our empty plates.
examples.zh: 服務生迅速收走了我們的空盤子。

examples.en: A taxi whisked us to the airport in twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 一輛計程車二十分鐘就把我們送到機場。

examples.en: The widower lives alone in a small apartment.
examples.zh: 那位鰥夫獨自住在一間小公寓。

examples.en: Neighbors often bring food to the old widower.
examples.zh: 鄰居常常送食物給那位年長的鰥夫。

examples.en: He became a widower at the age of sixty.
examples.zh: 他六十歲時成了鰥夫。

examples.en: The winger passed the ball to the striker.
examples.zh: 邊鋒把球傳給前鋒。

examples.en: Our school's best winger is very fast.
examples.zh: 我們學校最好的邊鋒跑得非常快。

examples.en: The coach moved him from midfield to winger.
examples.zh: 教練把他從中場調到邊鋒。

examples.en: The winning team received a gold cup.
examples.zh: 獲勝的隊伍得到一座金杯。

examples.en: She scored the winning goal in the last minute.
examples.zh: 她在最後一分鐘踢進了致勝的一球。

examples.en: The little boy has a winning smile.
examples.zh: 那個小男孩有迷人的笑容。

examples.en: He spent his winnings on a new bicycle.
examples.zh: 他把贏得的獎金拿去買一輛新腳踏車。

examples.en: The winnings were shared among the whole team.
examples.zh: 獎金分給了全隊成員。

examples.en: Her winnings from the contest paid for the trip.
examples.zh: 她比賽贏得的獎金付了這趟旅行的費用。

examples.en: You can make a cash withdrawal at the ATM.
examples.zh: 你可以在自動提款機提領現金。

examples.en: The doctor explained that suddenly stopping some medicines can cause withdrawal symptoms.
examples.zh: 醫師說明，突然停用某些藥物可能引起戒斷症狀。

examples.en: His withdrawal from the club surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 他退出社團讓大家很驚訝。

examples.en: The bridge was built to withstand strong typhoons.
examples.zh: 這座橋的設計能承受強烈颱風。

examples.en: These boots can withstand heavy rain and mud.
examples.zh: 這雙靴子經得起大雨和泥濘。

examples.en: Few small shops can withstand such high rent.
examples.zh: 很少有小商店撐得住這麼高的租金。

examples.en: Many shops woo customers with big discounts.
examples.zh: 許多商店用大折扣來爭取顧客。

examples.en: He tried to woo her with flowers and letters.
examples.zh: 他試著用花和信件追求她。

examples.en: The city hopes to woo more tourists this summer.
examples.zh: 這座城市希望今年夏天吸引更多遊客。

examples.en: We went for a walk in the woodland behind the village.
examples.zh: 我們到村子後面的林地散步。

examples.en: Many birds live in the woodland near the lake.
examples.zh: 許多鳥類棲息在湖邊的樹林裡。

examples.en: The woodland path was covered with fallen leaves.
examples.zh: 林間小徑鋪滿了落葉。

senses.zh: 體力或技術工人（通常指男性）

examples.en: A workman came to fix the water pipe.
examples.zh: 一位工人來修水管。

examples.en: The workmen are painting the school fence.
examples.zh: 工人們正在粉刷學校的圍籬。

examples.en: He is a skilled workman who takes pride in his work.
examples.zh: 他是個技術純熟的工匠，對自己的工作感到自豪。

examples.en: The weather will worsen in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午天氣會轉壞。

examples.en: Lack of sleep can worsen your headache.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足會讓你的頭痛更嚴重。

examples.en: The traffic worsened after the heavy rain started.
examples.zh: 大雨開始下之後，交通變得更糟。

examples.en: The would-be singer practiced every night after school.
examples.zh: 那位想成為歌手的人每天放學後都練習。

examples.en: Many would-be buyers came to see the house.
examples.zh: 許多有意購屋的人來看這間房子。

examples.en: A would-be author gave me a copy of his story.
examples.zh: 一位想當作家的人給了我一份他的故事。
